name: Dynamic D - Flow-rate change and chemical arrival time (illustrative)
description: Corrosion inhibitor and biocide are injecting continuously at steady state. Stop the biocide (close CIV-303), then change the choke: the production velocity changes, so the time the biocide tail takes to reach AT-531 and AT-532 changes. All data ILLUSTRATIVE.
briefing: Both chemicals start at their steady, fully-mixed concentrations along the flowline.
Close CIV-303 and note the plug-flow transit estimates in the Chemicals panel.
Open the choke (e.g. 30 % -> 60 %) or close it (-> 15 %) and compare when AT-531 / AT-532 fall: higher flow, shorter transit.
